events.event_hazard: Torrential rainstorm and floods; rain-triggered landslide
key_impacts: 198 people were killed in the storm across central El Salvador.
In Fenadesal Sur, 30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 damaged.
About 300 residents at risk in Fenadesal Sur evacuated to safety.
The Acelhuate River became a torrent, ripping away bridges and obliterating homes.
A major landslide occurred in the town of Verapaz after heavy rains.
evidence_snippets: A torrential rainstorm pounded the central provinces of El Salvador in November 2009… One hundred ninety-eight people were killed.
November’s storm struck the town of Fenadesal Sur… 14 inches of rain in four hours… 30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged… 300 people… made it to safety.
Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in the town of Verapaz.
missing_information: Exact day of the November 2009 event is not specified.
